name: DISA STIG — Web Server SRG V4R5
description: DISA Web Server Security Requirements Guide V4R5 — 126 findings. This audit covers the subset assessable without server config access. Authentic V-IDs, SRG-APP references, CCI mappings, and NIST 800-53 controls per the official STIG.
honest_disclosure: Python http.server is a development server, not a production web server. Most DISA STIG requirements are unassessable without production server (NGINX/Apache) config access. This audit reports honestly on the 6 items verifiable from static files + live HTTP inspection.

assessability_legend.http_live: Verifiable via live HTTP response headers
assessability_legend.config_required: Requires web server config file or SSH access
assessability_legend.not_applicable: Not applicable to Python http.server or static sites

group_policies.name: SC-8: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
group_policies.description: TLS encryption, protocol versions, cipher suites, HSTS — CCI-000068, CCI-002418

items.description: SRG-APP-000439-WSR-000151: The web server must employ cryptographic mechanisms (TLS/DTLS/SSL) preventing unauthorized disclosure of information during transmission.
items.remediation: Deploy TLS 1.2/1.3 with valid certificate. Python http.server does not support TLS — deploy NGINX reverse proxy.

items.description: SRG-APP-000439-WSR-000156: The web server must maintain confidentiality through use of an approved TLS version (TLS 1.2+ only per NIST SP 800-52).
items.remediation: Configure ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3 in nginx.conf. Disable TLS 1.0 and 1.1.

items.description: SRG-APP-000172-WSR-000104: The web server must encrypt passwords during transmission.
items.remediation: All authentication traffic must be encrypted with TLS. Deploy HTTPS.

items.description: SRG-APP-000439-WSR-000154: Cookies must have HttpOnly property set to prohibit client-side scripts from reading cookie data.
items.remediation: Configure web server to set HttpOnly flag on all session cookies. In NGINX: proxy_cookie_path with HttpOnly.

items.description: SRG-APP-000439-WSR-000155: Cookies must have Secure property set to force encryption of cookies.
items.remediation: Configure web server to set Secure flag on all cookies. Requires HTTPS.

items.description: SRG-APP-000223-WSR-000011: Cookies must have security settings that disallow cookie access outside the originating web server and application.
items.remediation: Configure SameSite=Strict or SameSite=Lax on all cookies. Set proper Domain and Path attributes.

group_policies.name: CM-6/CM-7: Configuration Settings & Least Functionality
group_policies.description: Error messages, directory listing, sample code — CCI-001312, CCI-001310, CCI-000381

items.description: SRG-APP-000266-WSR-000159: Warning and error messages must be modified to minimize identity of the web server, patches, loaded modules, and directory paths.
items.remediation: Create custom error pages for 40x/50x errors. Remove default error messages that leak server identity.

items.description: SRG-APP-000266-WSR-000142: The web server must display a default hosted application web page, not a directory listing, when a requested web page cannot be found.
items.remediation: Disable directory listing (autoindex off). Place default web page in every document directory.

items.description: SRG-APP-000141-WSR-000077: The web server must provide install options to exclude installation of documentation, sample code, example applications, and tutorials.
items.remediation: Remove all sample code, documentation, example files, and test directories from production web server.

items.description: AS24-U1-000010: The web server must limit the number of allowed simultaneous session requests (KeepAlive On, MaxKeepAliveRequests >= 100).
items.remediation: Set KeepAlive On and MaxKeepAliveRequests 100 in NGINX/httpd.conf.

items.description: SRG-APP-000439-WSR-000192: The web server must use HTTP/2 at a minimum. HTTP/1.x tunneling through HTTPS is not approved.
items.remediation: Enable HTTP/2 in NGINX: listen 443 ssl http2. Note: browsers require HTTPS for HTTP/2.

group_policies.name: Supplemental Security Headers (Best Practice — Not in Web Server SRG V4R5)
group_policies.description: CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, HSTS, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy. These are NOT explicit DISA STIG requirements but are industry best practices included for completeness. They appear in other STIGs (Application Security STIG, browser STIGs) and NIST SP 800-53 controls.

items.description: [SUPPLEMENTAL] SRG-APP-000015-WSR-000014: HSTS must be configured with max-age >= 31536000 and includeSubDomains. Referenced in broader TLS requirement V-206434. Explicitly required in browser STIGs and NIST SC-13.
items.regulation: NIST SC-13 | Mozilla Observatory | Supplemental — not in Web Server SRG V4R5
items.remediation: Add Strict-Transport-Security header: add_header Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains" always;

items.description: [SUPPLEMENTAL] Content-Security-Policy must restrict script sources. Not in Web Server SRG V4R5 but required by NIST SC-7(18) and Application Security STIG.
items.regulation: NIST SC-7(18) | Supplemental — not in Web Server SRG V4R5
items.remediation: Add restrictive CSP header without 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval'. Use nonces or hashes for inline scripts.

items.description: [SUPPLEMENTAL] X-Frame-Options must be DENY or SAMEORIGIN to prevent clickjacking. Not in Web Server SRG V4R5 but required by NIST SC-7 and browser STIGs.
items.regulation: NIST SC-7 | Supplemental — not in Web Server SRG V4R5
items.remediation: Add X-Frame-Options: DENY header or CSP frame-ancestors 'none'.

items.description: [SUPPLEMENTAL] X-Content-Type-Options must be nosniff to prevent MIME sniffing. Not in Web Server SRG V4R5 but required by NIST SC-7.
items.regulation: NIST SC-7 | Supplemental — not in Web Server SRG V4R5

items.description: [SUPPLEMENTAL] Referrer-Policy must restrict referrer leakage. Not in Web Server SRG V4R5 but recommended by NIST SC-7.
items.regulation: NIST SC-7 | Supplemental — not in Web Server SRG V4R5

items.description: [SUPPLEMENTAL] Permissions-Policy must restrict browser features. Not in Web Server SRG V4R5 but recommended by NIST SC-7.
items.regulation: NIST SC-7 | Supplemental — not in Web Server SRG V4R5
